q: In the dispute-triage project, what is disp-lgbm-v3?
a: The current dispute classifier (2026-09-14) that scores cards.disputes for auto-resolution, using TF-IDF reason text, amount band, transaction match, merchant chargeback rate and the fraud-2026 score. It reaches 95.3% precision at p>=0.95 with 29% coverage on disp-oot-2026h1 (exp-307).

q: What came of the 96.1% auto-resolve precision finding in dispute-triage (disp-find-autoresolve-96)?
a: It was overturned on 2026-06-02: out-of-sample precision at p>=0.90 was 93.4% (exp-304) and 92.7% on April 2026 labels (exp-306). disp-find-precision-real replaced it, and dec-disp-autoresolve-095 raised the threshold to 0.95.

q: What does disp-lgbm-v3 depend on outside dispute-triage?
a: disp-lgbm-v3 uses feat-disp-fraud-score, which takes the score from fraud-2026/fraud26-gbm-v3 for each dispute's original authorisation. It is trained on the analyst labels in ds-disp-analyst-labels and on cards.disputes in ds-disp-disputes.

q: What auto-resolve threshold does the dispute-triage project run now?
a: p>=0.95 on disp-lgbm-v3 (dec-disp-autoresolve-095, with the fraud score added by dec-disp-fraud-score-in on 2026-09-03). It replaced the 0.90 pilot of dec-disp-autoresolve-090.

q: What precision and coverage did disp-lgbm-v2 reach at p>=0.90 on disp-oot-2026h1?
a: 93.4% precision and 31% coverage on 5,210 two-analyst-labelled disputes from Jan-Mar 2026 (exp-304, evaluated 2026-04-14).

q: Why was the dispute-triage auto-resolve threshold raised from 0.90 to 0.95?
a: dec-disp-autoresolve-095 (2026-06-19): out-of-sample precision at 0.90 was 92.7-93.4% against a 95% target, after the earlier 96.1% in-sample result (disp-find-autoresolve-96) was overturned by disp-find-precision-real.
